Frequently asked questions about functional ingredients

What are functional ingredients used for?

Functional Ingredients can support texture, stability, flavour, processing and production consistency across relevant finished-food applications. The exact function depends on the selected product and grade.

Which functional ingredients does Vikranth supply?

This page lists GMS Flakes, GMS Powder, Sorbitan Monostearate, Finamul 90, DMG, PGMS, SMS, PGPR, Soya Lecithin, Whey Protein, Whey Powder, Soya Protein, Vital Wheat Gluten, Skimmed Milk Powder, Calcium Carbonate, Calcium Chloride, Sodium Citrate, Propylene Glycol (PG), Refined Glycerine. Current grade, pack size, stock and manufacturer availability are confirmed for each enquiry.

Can I buy functional ingredients in bulk in Chennai?

Vikranth accepts B2B enquiries in Chennai. Share the product, grade, quantity, delivery area and timeline so current supply details can be checked.

Can functional ingredients be supplied across India?

Pan-India business enquiries are welcome. Delivery coverage, freight, lead time and minimum quantity depend on the product and destination and are confirmed before quotation.

Can I request product specifications, COA or a sample?

Yes. State the product, application and trial quantity. Specific documents and samples remain subject to product and manufacturer availability.

Which ingredient is suitable for my application?

Share the finished product, process, target performance, required grade, expected quantity and timeline so relevant available options can be reviewed and trialled.
